auth.title: Hetzner Cloud API Token
auth.subtitle: Connect your Hetzner Cloud project using a personal API token
guideSteps: Open Hetzner Cloud Console > Choose your Project
Navigate to Security > API Tokens > Generate API Token with Read & Write permissions
Paste the token into the field below and click 'Verify & Connect Account'
